title: Cipher-breaker's tally
hints: Letters are consecutive numbers: `'c' - 'a'` is `2`. That turns a letter into an index from 0 to 25.
First set all 26 counts to 0 (the caller's array may hold garbage). Then, for each character that `isalpha` accepts, lowercase it and add one to `counts[c - 'a']`.
`for (int k = 0; k < 26; k++) counts[k] = 0; for (size_t i = 0; s[i]; i++) { unsigned char c = (unsigned char)s[i]; if (isalpha(c)) counts[tolower(c) - 'a']++; }`
